title: rosa × dumetorum subvar. perciliata
intro: Rosa × dumetorum subvar. perciliata, commonly known as the Rosa rugosa, is a species of fragrant, pink-flowered, shrub-like rose native to East Asia. The Rosa rugosa has been traditionally used in medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, sore throat, and skin conditions, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Rosa rugosa include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils. The bioactive constituents of Rosa rugosa have been shown to possess anti-cancer, anti-diabetic, and cardiovascular-protective properties, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
